text_fidelity_a:
Assassin’s Creed Syndicate Assassin's Gauntlet with Hidden Blade This is so much nicer than the cane sword. It fits on the left hand and the blade ejects with a snick kind of sound, and quite a bit of force. It's spring loaded, and if you look very closely you can see the spring, but I could imagine the "original" was the same. It's heavy leather and has gorgeous detailing. This one is worthy of Comicon or serious cos play.

The "metal" looks aged aged, a little oxidized, and not at all like plastic. It barely feels like plastic when you run your fingers over it, only a bit too warm in the cold weather. The leather looks distressed, and a bit worn, even on the inside by the knuckles. The stitching in the leather is impeccable, and with a great eye for detail. Some of the stitches are a tad longer than others, which happens with hand sewing, not typically with machine stitching. Yes, it was clearly done by machine, but the effect is to look pre-industrial which fits the game perfectly. There is even fake dirt in the spring of the grapple line.

The buckles on top are non-functional. It stays on with velcro straps on the bottom. It fits my small woman hands only barely and I imagine would be fine on a fairly tall man as well.

As with the cane, this is not for kids. The blade is on the sharp side, as is the assassin logo grapple point (I didn't notice in the game that the hook is the logo -- very cool detail). It could do some damage, especially if pointed to the eyes, and the grapple hook is a bit delicate looking. Nothing serious, but handle with some care.
text_fidelity_b: Assassin’s Creed Syndicate Assassin's Gauntlet with Hidden Blade

The bones are made of rubber, not plastic, and the dog dishes are sturdy cardboard (which may or may not hold up, given that many pre-schoolers are hard on games and toys. At the end, children count the number of bones Shelby has stolen, practicing their counting skills in a fun way.  I recommend this game to anyone who is looking for a fairly sturdy educational game that a pre-schooler will love.  A testimony from Brandon's mom, Laura:  "I love this game!"

ETA hand2mind Connecting People, Set of 96 This educational toy consists of small, easily swallowed pieces, making it a choking hazard. Thus, it is not recommended for children younger than age 5 and should be kept well away from pets, especially puppies who like to chew things. This toy is recommended for grades K-4, which is approximately ages 5-9. It's primary purpose is helping children learn counting. They can also use it to learn to sort and classify.

The set includes 96 pieces of sturdy, plastic, free-standing, girl and boy figures. Half are male and half female. The pieces come in three sizes, each in four colors, yellow, red, green and blue. The sizes are all rather small, ranging from only 1/2 inch to 1 inch in height. The larger figures weigh about 3-4 grams and the smallest figures weigh about 1 gram. The figures are well made in terms of having smooth surfaces, which is important to avoid harming small fingers. The figures are stored in a zip-lock type plastic bag.

As advertised, the pieces do stand up by themselves, and they can be linked together. However, it can be difficult for younger children to clip them together. They each have a protruding peg on one hand and a hole on the other hand. It takes hand-eye coordination to match up a peg and a hole, and some finger strength to shove a peg into a hole. Taking them apart is even harder. Thus, this toy can be frustrating to kids on the younger end of the recommended age range, 5-6 years old, and is most likely to be handled smoothly by children on the higher end of the scale, age 7-9. Some of these problems might have been avoided if the figures came in larger sizes.
text_fidelity_b: ETA hand2mind Connecting People, Set of 96

I'm not sure where he saw it, but all of a sudden he wants nothing but Sonic. However, Sonic isn't really popular right now. There is the pending "live-action" Sonic movie, but that has been pushed back from November to Winter/Spring of 2020 so any tie-in toys will also probably be pushed back. So, this RC car was the only thing I could really find that wasn't exorbitantly priced.

This currently priced at $27, but I would say it's really not worth more than $20. It's really light weight and does not come with batteries. So, keep that in mind when you are giving this as a gift. The car and the remote both need batteries. AA and AAA. Sonic is part of the car. He does not come out. And this operates just like any other R/C car. There's nothing special about it other than it is Sonic. The headlights turn on when going forward and turn off when in reverse. My so has launched this off the porch and into the front yard several times. It's only about 6 inches down from the porch to the ground, so I doubt there's any real damage, but I would caution against doing that from any heights above that. However, I would say that he has played with this for a couple minutes and then moved onto something else. Without any other bells and whistles, the hold factor for this toys wasn't very long. Keep in mind while my son loves Sonic, he doesn't play the video games or do much on electronic devices. So, he actually plays with toys most of his day.

So, I think this is a nice, cute gift, but I think it is a bit over priced.
text_fidelity_b: NKOK RC Sonic SSAS R2 Car with Lights, Blue (614)

BOMENNE Build-on Brick Mug,Funny Novelty Coffee Mug Compatible with Lego,Creative DIY Building Blocks Cup,Birthday Party Cups For Kids,Unique Gifts For Christmas,Black I should have read some of the reviews before wasting money on these mugs.

I have spent the last 90 minutes trying to decorate this mug. The parts sent with the mug do not attach; you can place them but they immediately fall off. Those parts fit to one another very well, but they decline to play nicely (or at all) with their mug.

I tried LEGO pieces and they do not want to be pressed onto the mug. I really cannot blame them.

The only block pieces that do fit onto the mug are ones I had purchased from Dollar Tree. They meld easily with the mug and hold beautifully. Unfortunately, the only surface that will accept them is the front of the mug. As you can see from the pictures they are holding well, but the rest of the mug surfaces are...well, I am trying so hard not to be all negative and everything, but the mug is so poorly designed and sloppily made that nohting will attach at all, not LEGO, not the mug company's blocks and not even the pieces of white bread that I smushed together and tried to mold to the pegs and holes. It stuck whilst still moist and them fell off when it dried and I picked up the mug to check.

We are a totally dedicated LEGO family. We have even indoctrinated...coerced...um...lovingly brought my son-in-law into the LEGO Love. We give and share those precious bricks at every gifting opportunity. There have been times when my grandchildren are out playing with their friends and my daughter and I are still inside playing. I recently learned that the one set she would love to have is the Friend's Heartlake Hotel, but by that time it was already hovering around $400.00. I am thinking that I will make provisions in my will for her to have one.

Sadly, I bought two of these. Double the heartbreak. Do not buy this unless you are planning to do what I intend to do with them. I have a tiny ton of old costume jewelry that I use for crafting and I am going to use Gorilla Glue to cover the mug with some cool bits and bobs of jewelry. That will be a totally huge and groovy improvement to the really quite pathetic red C that is now on the mug. I am an old granny and am surprised how disappointed I am with this mug.

Please protect your loved ones and buy something else. You can buy some nice real LEGO packs for the $26.00 I wasted on this crap, or a very large amount of blocks and accessories of the blocks sold at Dollar Tree. Tell them I sent you.

Love,
Granny

Pantasy Saint Seiya Building Kit, Sagittarius Aiolos Action Figure Level Building Sets for Adults, Creative Art Collectible Model for Home or Office, Soul of Gold - Saint Cloth Myth EX Building Blocks Pantasy makes amazing building sets, with pieces that usually stay together and super clear instructions. There are some untranslated dialogue boxes here and there, but the diagrams are so clear that I was never confused.

This set of Saint Seiya is something of a mix between a figure and a building set. The base is a traditional building set, and then Saint Seiya is a somewhat poseable figure. The neck, shoulders, knees, ankles, and wings have ball and socket joints for articulation. The elbows have gears that limit movement somewhat. The hips can move forward and backward only. The hands have small ball and socket connectors, but they don’t always hold the positions I set.

I usually really like sets from Pantasy, but this one fell a little short for me in the figure itself. It keeps breaking when I try to put it on the stand, or if I try to pose it too much. This is a set you build and then put on display, somewhere it won’t be bumped. I’ve tried several times to get the feet attached to the base, but end up relying on the clear support on the back of the base, which has a rod to attach to a hole on the figure’s back.

I’ve had the wings fall off, the hands fall off, armor pieces fall off, you name it, it’s fallen off. One of the wings has a loose connection and continually falls off. I have built several sets from Pantasy, none with this problem.

I think the armor is actually fantastic, all metallic gold pieces that match in color. Many of the bigger pieces are wrapped in extra plastic to prevent scratches. The bow and arrow are nestled in foam in a separate box; the packaging is impressive, on par with a UCS set.

There are two face options, and an extra hand if you don’t want to use the bow. There are some great building techniques like SNOT, and as I said, the instructions are very clear. This is an 18+ set, but I think anyone could handle it.
text_fidelity_b: Pantasy Saint Seiya Building Kit, Sagittarius Aiolos Action Figure Level Building Sets for Adults, Creative Art Collectible Model for Home or Office, Soul of Gold - Saint Cloth Myth EX Building Blocks

Legacy Deluxe Mancala Classic Game with Folding Wooden Game Board and Colored Glass Stones, Family Game for Ages 8 and up Chess has been my favorite board game since I was a child and I have collected chess sets as a hobby over the years. When I selected this one I expected it to be on par with typical portable wooden sets which are usually cheaply made. This one was a pleasant surprise in that it is a step up from most portable wooden sets I have seen and used.

This is a fairly straightforward set. The case is a clamshell design that folds open into the board. There are magnets in the rim of the underside of the board to hold it closed when the set is not in use, ands the manufacturer did a decent job of concealing the contacts (though they are visible if you look for them). The squares on the board are smooth and while the seams between the squares can be felt when you run your hand along the board, the seams are smooth and are less pronounced that what I have seen on some other boards.

The pieces are decently made though are nothing special. They are machine cut pieces and have been smoothed, sanded and varnished. They are weighted nicely and have felt on the bottom to avoid scratching the board. They’re a fairly average design but they look good and are very recognizable.

The main feature of this set is that it is larger than most fold-out boards I have seen and used. While this might not be the best for packing and portability, I really like the size. I am less likely to knock over pieces accidentally and I can see what’s going on a little better.

This is not just a chess set but includes wood chips for playing checkers as well. The chips are small and are nothing of note but they are sufficient.

I really like this chess set and will use it as my main travel set moving forward. I like the size of the board, the feel of the pieces and the overall quality. There are better sets out there but they cost more. There are less expensive sets too, and the chances of finding one that is of the same quality as this one for less is small.
text_fidelity_b: Legacy Deluxe Mancala Classic Game with Folding Wooden Game Board and Colored Glass Stones, Family Game for Ages 8 and up

text_fidelity_a:
Swimways Dry Float Lounger Pool Float, Translucent Inflatable Recliner Chair for Adults with Fast Inflation, Foot Rest & Cup Holder These products, both the dry float lounger and the socializer are prime examples of why I test products the way I do prior to writing my review.

When I initially received these products and inflated them I was fairly impressed with the design and comfort - by 18 days later both were flat lumps of rubber in the trash.

First the socializer never held air. After inflation by the following morning it had deflated to around 70% capacity. I put it under water in the pool and discovered multiple small defects in 2 seams.

The dry float lounger lasted a bit longer at 18 days but then was found flat due to a separation at the seam.

It is important to note neither of these were ever used by children or in any rough play as when I review products I adhere to strict guidelines - and there are no children in the home.

While the socializer is listed as a dry float it appears the user’s calves and feet would be in the water. The lounger pool float is perfect for those who prefer to float completely out of the water. When floating on this no part of the body is submerged in the water.

While 88-90% of the world’s population is right handed this manufacturer chose to place the cup holder on the left side and made it too small to hold a standard 12 Oz can for both of these floats. This is simply poor designing.

While these floats come with a small patch kit, these are only helpful when repairing a puncture and absolutely will not hold a torn seam.

While these floats appeared to have promise initially, in well under a month they proved to be poorly designed, and of substandard construction and materials.

I would not recommend either of these products.
text_fidelity_b: Swimways Dry Float Lounger Pool Float, Translucent Inflatable Recliner Chair for Adults with Fast Inflation, Foot Rest & Cup Holder

I build on our dining room table but when I have to clean up, I have to put away all the pieces and cover the whole thing with paper or posterboard because my cat sits on it, eats pieces, throws up on it, or tosses pieces to the floor.

I have been looking for a puzzle board/ storage solution for a while and found this one: The medium 1500 piece size is a good size for most of the puzzles that I do. It is sturdy and was packaged beautifully (foam on the back and front and around the corners as well). It arrived perfectly with no issues. This board showcases 6 drawers - 2 different sizes and a plexi cover for the puzzle. While larger, it was easy to move around as long as you don't tilt it (drawers may fall out). Aside from puzzling, I think this would be a great board to use for boardgames as well especially those with lots of player/playing pieces, because you can house/hide them in the drawers (up to 6 players).

For the cost, it seems a little underdone. The particle board is plain, it is a bit on the heavier side, and there is no felt that you can find on some boards.

Overall, I am enjoying my use of this product. It is getting the job done, especially if you are tormented by a cat like I am.

K.T. Fancy 35 PCS Doll Clothes and Accessories 5 Fashion Clothes Sets 5 Fashion Skirts 14 Outfit Accessories10 Shoes and A Dog for 11.5 inch Doll I recently got name-brand Barbie clothes, and I also tried this generic aftermarket version. Here’s how they compare:

Value:
This set comes with 35 pieces for $17, while the Barbie brand comes with about the same amount for $40. As far as quality goes, the Barbie brand far exceeds this in materials and construction, and it also includes things that fit the male dolls, where as this one doesn’t. With the Barbie brand, you also know exactly what you’re getting, whereas with this one, it’s more of a grab bag, where some of the outfits pictured arrive, and others are substituted for similar items (but definitely not the same). For value, it’s a draw.

Quality:
In terms of textiles, construction, and details, Barbie wins by a lot. These are OK, with some that are pretty great actually, but some that are not. For example, a few of these have vinyl appliqués that don’t look quite right, as well as other small irregularities. At the same time, there’s nothing huge as far as quality goes that would make me think these are bad. They’re fine, and many are quite cute!

Accessories:
New her Barbies tend to have flat feet, so the high heels mostly don’t work, and this assortment primarily comes with the super high heels that work with the old fashion Barbies. As cute as these are, they’re generally not going to work. Also, there wasn’t any jewelry really in this mix. The Barbie mix had a lot of matching bracelet and necklace sets, which I liked; The namebrand also had more flat shoes, which means the flat footed Barbies had plenty to wear. Barbie wins this category as well.

Overall:
If you are on a budget, and you are not trying to dress any male dolls, this is a perfectly fine assortment. There are plenty of neat designs and cool fabrics. If you have male dolls that want outfits, however, and you prefer more quality over quantity, I recommend the Barbie set.

Nature Bound Bug Catcher Critter Barn Habitat for Indoor/Outdoor Insect Collecting with Light Kit, White Very cool when used with adult supervision and a LOT of info about what is humane and what isn't. I've definitely seen some kids use this type of cage as a permanent home for their reptiles or frogs, and that is 100% wrong. Animals need space, and while keeping a terrarium can be great for kids to learn about living things, life, death, responsibility, etc, parents are obligated to do research on what size is correct for what animal(s) to ensure they have a decent quality of life.

Having said all that, this is not meant to be a permanent home for any sort of reptile or amphibian. It's a place to observe creatures for a Short time, and then release them. For that use, it is fine. For anything longer than a couple of days, it is cruel.

Some neat features: the light (of course!), a ruler at the bottom so kids can measure the animal without handling or harassing them too much, a magnifying lens (but it only works a little--you need to be in the right spot for that to do anything), and a little mini lid on top, which is especially useful if there's a reptile, amphibian, or spider inside, and you want to introduce an insect for it to eat.

Nice hands-on educational potential!
text_fidelity_b: Nature Bound Bug Catcher Critter Barn Habitat for Indoor/Outdoor Insect Collecting with Light Kit, White

Crayola My Virtual Fashion Show Crayola My Virtual Fashion Show is a fun way for your little fashion diva to spend some free time. All you do is download the application on your smartphone, tablet, or iPod touch, draw some fashion designs, and then scan them. Your fashion will then show up on an actual fashion model, in 3D, to your child’s delight.

My girls are fashion designers in the making so I knew they would love playing with the Crayola My Virtual Fashion Show. It takes little effort to get going. You just add the application to your smartphone or tablet, and then have your child start drawing. Once scanned through the application, kids will be able to see their own fashion design on an actual model. This caused squeals of satisfaction from my girls who loved seeing their fashion on screen.

From my children’s perspectives, there is little that isn’t perfect with a toy like this, but as an adult, I can see a few issues. One has already been stated by others who have used the device, but bears repeating: The phone or tablet you use will make a difference. Not all smartphones or tablets are created equally and the colors may look a little off. If you have more than one device and it doesn’t look good on one, then you might want to consider downloading the application to another device. It could make a difference and it’s simple enough to do.

The included accessories with the Crayola My Virtual Fashion Show are a little limited. The small colored pencils are also somewhat of an obstacle, as they are not good for larger hands. But overall, this is a fun fashion design kit and I cannot imagine a fashion- loving child who wouldn’t fall in love with it.
text_fidelity_b: Crayola My Virtual Fashion Show

Schleich Dinosaurs, Realistic Large Dinosaur Toys for Boys and Girls, Barapasaurus Toy Figurine, Ages 4+ As usual with Schleich toys, you can’t fault the durability or the quality. I’ve reviewed a number of them, and I can’t speak highly enough of their quality builds. They are made to last, even if roughly played with. We’ve had several now for about a decade, and they look no different than when they arrived, despite having gone through a number of dino “battles” and the like. This one is no exception. One issue I suppose is that it may be a little over-built in that it has quite a heft to it, which may preclude younger children from playing easily with it. It’s sizable already, but add the weight and I can see small hands having a difficult time picking it up and moving it around, or certainly moving it smoothly. Once you move past the toddler years, though, that will be much less of an issue.

In terms of looks, it’s nicely painted (again, as usual with Schleich), with the blue cuts running down central area from head to tail tip standing out particularly nicely. The pose is as if it is about to take a step forward or perhaps step on something (someone?). The face is my one real complaint about this model. It’s a raw sort of red color, which isn’t all that aesthetic. It almost looks like it’s been flayed, or perhaps is furiously angry. And there’s something about the mouth being open in the manner it is that just seems a bit off-putting.But at least the teeth look like the right sort (I hate when one has, for instance, obviously carnivorous teeth on herbivores).

It’s nice to have a new model and a relatively unknown one at that. Outside of the head/face, which is a relatively minor complaint, the barapasuaruk is another fine addition to a great line of toys/models.

It’s cool that the manufacturer thought to add this because it’s practical and better ensures that pieces don’t get lost.

Teaching problem- solving skills to young people can be accomplished in many ways and a toy like the Wooden Jigsaw Puzzle set from Lemostaar is useful for this purpose. Franklin Sports Giant Wooden Dice These dice are beautifully made of solid pine. Playing games with these are fun but play responsibly. Displaying the dice as works of art is equally as great.

Provided in the package:
- Six die that weigh a combined 4.6 pounds. (See the attached pictures for an idea of size relative to two of my cats and their water fountain.)
- A strong canvas pouch for carrying the dice.
- A folded one-page pamphlet with two game variations and a sample score card for copying.

Each die is beautiful and each "number point" (i.e. dots) on the same die face is painted a rich coffee brown or dark tan. However, the "number points" are various shades of coffee brown on each side of the same die, so there is a slight inconsistency in color there. Nevertheless, this does not take away from their beauty. One should discount the "life-sized" claim. They are large but all of them stacked three high, side-by-side, do not even reach the height of a poised cat as you can see from my photos. When used for play instead of art, the round edge of each die provides for a smooth roll and reduction of injury to property or person. Although this is rated for ages 6 and above, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND children, adults, and pets stay far back when rolling the dice.

My boyfriend and I played the first game on my inside carpet since it was raining outside. I made sure to remove any items that could break around the area we were playing and I had to keep shooing the cats away. I originally thought we had to roll all six die at once (which is impossible). Therefore, when playing the two games in the instructions, roll each die one at a time because they are too large to roll together. The instructions should say that, however, because the first thought I had is "How am I going to roll these six die all at once," when the instructions said "roll the dice"?

My boyfriend loved the dice and the game even though I won. Since each die is heavy, it is extremely important to throw each die gently. I can see unsupervised children or drunk adults throwing these at each other and causing serious damage or death. As long as everyone plays responsibly, hours of fun and friendly competition are awaiting those who play this lawn or carpeted basement "game."
text_fidelity_b: Franklin Sports Giant Wooden Dice

That's pretty much what you're going to hear when you present this gift to a small person. A bunch of wows, and then a bunch of roaring after you get it out of the package and they start playing with it. There are two buttons in the middle of the T Rex, one of which works the tail and the other of which works the head and snapping jaws. The buttons are a little hard to press effectively to make the action occur, so small T Rex fans might have a little more trouble activating things than one might like, but there's a next to it, which bigger guys will soon figure out.

I picked this up because I have a Jurassic world toys truck, which is supposed to hold the dinosaur in the back. There's like this included shell that comes up over the top and is supposed to have the dinosaur's head sticking up out of the shell, and I thought that this T Rex, being from the same line, would fit gracefully in the back of that truck. Nope, this thing is huge. Huge huge. Check the measurements before expecting this to dovetail with any other toys because T Rex is a big dude.

The size and the snapping jaws action really contributes to the awesome gift presentation this makes. Does it have a lot of long-term play potential? I'm not really sure that it does, frankly. I think in our house, once I get tired of tripping over it, I'm going to relegate it to being a backyard toy and just allow it to slowly stop working. However, right now the kids are having a blast creating scenes for T Rex to come in and stomp. He is particularly good it crashing through block towers.

LEGO Friends Mia’s Play Cube 41403 Building Kit, Playset Includes Collectible Mini-Doll, for Imaginative Play, New 2020 (40 Pieces) The idea of this Lego Play Cube is pretty cute. I’m dating myself here, but it reminds me a bit of Polly Pockets. But just better, because Lego.

There’s not a ton to build here, compared to other sets in this price point. There’s only 40 pieces in the set, many of which are small vet tools. The cube is the big draw.

My favorite part for this set, and actually for all the play cubes, is that the surprise is always the same animal. For example, Mia always comes with a rabbit. It’s the color of the animal that is the surprise. The colors are pink, purple, blue, or gold.

The box includes a mini poster that shows all the play cubes and the pets they come with. The poster also indicates there will be a Series 2 of the play cubes.

I wish that instead of using traditional stickers, Lego had gone with something like window clings or small decals, so that kids could more easily decorate and change the look of the cubes. Because the builds are somewhat bland, it’s really the stickers that add life to this set. I think it would be so much cooler if kids could swap the stickers.

I have never been to Portofino, but after having worked on this for upwards of a month, the harbor is definitely now on my bucket list. The colors are vibrant, the pieces are sturdy and the finished picture is breathtaking and definitely framable (if you are into doing that with your puzzles). It is challenging, yet fairly easy to do. Would think this is more for an adult with a passion for travel and the old country (more so than for a young child). I would highly reccommend this to anyone who loves jigsaw puzzles. Ravensburger makes the best (in my opinion).

text_fidelity_a:
Animoodles Magnetic Hazel Sloth Stuffed Animal Plush, 7.5" , Brown Many stuffed plush toys that are equipped with joints are difficult to pose. Using magnets in the place of joints makes posing your stuffie very easy. There are currently 14 different Animoodles Magnetic Stuffed Animal Plush toys. Most popular animals among today's current toy trends are available. The plush material is incredibly soft and the embroidered features are incredibly cute. We were able to have Kylie the Cat join our household. Her limbs were each held into place with a plastic tab, which was not difficult to clip and remove completely.

Kylie came with a booklet that tells the origin story of the Animoodles with small written profiles and photos of each toy in the series. There are also practical safety warnings regarding the magnets used in the plush.

I had some concerns about magnets in a child's toy, but the smallest magnet I can feel through the fabric is about the size of a nickle. The stitching is solid, it would be difficult to remove the magnets. Kylie has a lemon bow stitched onto her head, the colors are very cohesive. The pupil of the eyes are buttons. I would strongly advise this toy to not be available to any child under 3 or any other children that are prone to putting random objects into their mouth or being overly destructive with their toys. The button eyes and internal magnets are simply not safe for babies, toddlers or destructive children, as it's made clear in the attached booklet.

The Animoodles Magnetic Stuffed Animal Plush would make a great gift for many children. However, Kylie was in a sealed plastic bag inside the shipping box, so this may be a gift that is better to present in a gift bag rather than wrapping unless you opt to use the shipping box. Play would be expanded with more Animoodles from the series. Additional Animoodles allow for any sort of crazy plush hybrid desired.

My favorite features of the Animoodles is the creative construction and the softness of the plush material. This would make a great addition to any plush animal collection.
text_fidelity_b: Animoodles Magnetic Hazel Sloth Stuffed Animal Plush, 7.5" , Brown
